description: This file contains a Python class 'BiasMonitor' that manages bias monitoring plots using Bokeh, including data loading from a database, updating visualizations, and handling instrument-specific logic for JWST bias data.

classes.name: BiasMonitor
classes.description: A class for monitoring bias data and generating Bokeh plots for JWST bias calibration.

methods.name: input_parameters
methods.description: Property getter and setter for instrument and aperture parameters.

methods.name: identify_tables
methods.description: Determines which database table to use based on the instrument.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Queries the database for bias data corresponding to the specified instrument and aperture.

methods.name: pre_init
methods.description: Initializes default values before further setup.

methods.name: post_init
methods.description: Loads data and updates visualizations after initialization.

methods.name: update_calibrated_histogram
methods.description: Updates the histogram plot of the calibrated 0th group.

methods.name: update_calibrated_image
methods.description: Updates the calibrated bias image display.

methods.name: update_collapsed_vals_figures
methods.description: Updates figures showing median-collapsed row and column data.

methods.name: update_mean_bias_figures
methods.description: Updates plots of mean bias over time for different amplifier channels.
